Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Houston, Texas, when Driver 1 began to move right to
change lanes. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the right lane, was alongside and the two vehicles made contact along
their sides, consistent with a sideswipe collision. Both drivers pulled to the shoulder after the impact. Drievr 1 reported
a wrist injury and was assisted by responding personnel. Independent witnesses at the scene stated that the collision
occurred in the manner Driver 1 and Drvier 2 described, and photographs taken on scene were consistent with their
accounts. Damage to the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle and the passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle matches the
reported point of impact. The Passenger, seated in Driver 1's vehicle, was not clearly identified as to seating posiiton
during the initial interview and was noted for follow-up. Some minor scratches on the lower rear quarter panel of
Dirver 1's vehicle may predate this incident and were noted for reference only. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on
the applicable policy.
